method.shortdesc: Exports the book to a file.

parameter.shortdesc: The export format, specified as an enumeration value or as an extension that appears in the Save as type or Format menu in the Export dialog. Can accept: ExportFormat enumerator or String.

parameter.shortdesc: The file to which to export the book. (Optional)

parameter.name: showingOptions
parameter.shortdesc: Used to specify if the PDF Export Options Dialog needs to be shown or not (Optional)

parameter.shortdesc: Used to specify the presets for the export which can be the object of the preset type, enumeration for existing presets or user defined presets, or a string naming the preset to be used, but in case Showing Options is true, the preset specified in the Export Dialog will over ride this parameter (Optional)

parameter.name: whichDocuments
